notes.title: 2024 Spring Sales - Save 50% on Arlo
notes.content:
[h2]Winter, go to hell ![/h2]

Each year, we enjoy you coming, thinking about Christmas and nice field of white snow.
Each year, we have a Uncle John drunk making terrible jokes during Christmas Eve, the gift we received was not matching at all with our expectation, the snow was brown and we are cold.

Spring is coming ! Sun, green trees, bird's whistle, opened window, fresh air ! Finally !

Until then, let's dance around some demons and release a Kraken or a phoenix into a mass of enemies.

[h3]What would you prefer: a fireball Gatling or a huge spear striking through everything ?[/h3]

notes.title: Quick fix - wording
notes.content:
Correction of wording "dodge". My apologies for that, English not being my mother tongue, I considered it the best word but I saw it confused several players.

The specific mechanic is about avoiding enemies but staying close. There is no mechanic to jump/dash/flash/disappear.

The word "dodge" is now replaced by "skirt".
I let you look on urban dictionary for the exact definition.

[h2]Stay close to your friends but closer to your enemies 😈[/h2]
